285157294.description:
Pilot Custom 823 Fountain Pen Set
Smoke Translucent Demonstrator with 14K Gold Nib
Includes 70ml Blue Ink & Presentation Box
The Pilot Custom 823 is celebrated as one of Japan's premier luxury writing instruments. Crafted with an engineered vacuum-plunger filling mechanism, the 823 provides an exceptional ink capacity paired with a sleek translucent smoke resin barrel. Fitted with a prestigious #15 size 14K gold nib, it exemplifies Pilot's century-long legacy of fine penmaking.
Smoke black resin body with polished gold-plated trim
Solid 14K gold Pilot #15 nib with ornate engraving
High-capacity vacuum plunger filling mechanism
Includes 70ml Pilot Blue ink bottle, original box, and care booklet
